findings.title: Asynchronous Vector Store Cleanup on Document Deletion
findings.description: When a document is soft-deleted or purged, PostgreSQL cascades delete chunks in the relational database, but remote Qdrant vectors rely on background or scoped collection point deletion. A failed vector deletion job could leave orphaned vectors in Qdrant.
findings.mitigation: The relational retrieval authorizer (app/retrieval/authorization.py) validates candidate IDs against PostgreSQL documents and filters out any deleted documents or chunks. Thus, orphaned vectors never reach the LLM context.
findings.recommendation: Add a scheduled reconciliation task in post-M05 to prune Qdrant vectors whose chunk_id no longer exists in PostgreSQL.

findings.title: CPU-Bound Document Parsing in Async Context
findings.description: PyMuPDF text extraction is CPU-bound. Large multi-megabyte PDFs could block the asyncio event loop if parsed synchronously in the main thread.
findings.mitigation: Current ingestion pipeline delegates ingestion jobs to background workers or threads via asyncio.to_thread.
findings.recommendation: Maintain strict upload file size limit (50 MB) and worker pool concurrency limits in production settings.

findings.title: Unused Imports in Static Dashboard Pages
findings.description: ESLint reported 19 unused variable/import warnings (e.g. Shield, Clock, PlusCircle) across dashboard pages. They do not block builds or cause runtime errors.
findings.mitigation: Verified next build passes with 0 errors.
findings.recommendation: Clean up unused Lucide imports during routine dashboard maintenance.
